stories.body: Neuroimaging studies have shown close overlap between neural representations of nociceptive stimuli and non-nociceptive, salient stimuli (such as low-probability sounds), leading to the proposal that nociception and salience share a common neural substrate in the human brain. stories.title: A global genomic survey of prokaryotic carbon fixation reveals an oxygen-tolerant rTCA cycle in the surface ocean
stories.body: Autotrophic carbon fixation, the conversion of inorganic carbon into biomass, underpins life on Earth. Prokaryotes can carry out this process via at least seven biochemically distinct pathways, yet the phylogenetic and environmental distribution of most remains poorly resolved. stories.title: TDP-43 toxic gain of function links ALS, FTD and Alzheimers Disease through splicing dysregulation
stories.body: TDP-43 proteinopathy is a hallmark of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) and frontotemporal lobar degeneration (FTLD). stories.title: SpiE is a distinct gut microbial 4-cholesten-3-one 5β-reductase that acts with SpiR to convert cholesterol to coprostanol
stories.body: Gut microbes convert cholesterol into coprostanol, a poorly absorbed sterol that is largely excreted in feces and is linked to lower serum cholesterol levels.
